title: File:Ghanashyam Dol 14.jpg
author: Nayan j Nath
description:
Ghanashyam Dol, a terracotta brick temple near Joysagar Tank, is believed to have been built during King Rajeswar Singha’s reign (1751–1769) for his grandson (naati) of Parbatiya Gosain, earning it the name Naati Gosain Dol. Another account links its origin to King Rudra Singha’s patronage, with Ghanashyam Khanikar credited for its construction.  .mw-parser-output .messagebox{margin:4px
